title: Research: obstruct two simple orders for the coupled T20 packing cap
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This scoped proof rules out two simple orders for the fixed PR #3148/PR #3153 coupled inventory. Stage-major and replica-major orders force at least **1,857** and **7,500** capacity-eight bins away from the only tight pattern `[8]` at T20. The written lower bounds are **78T+297** and **375T** for every positive T, including arbitrary replica permutations within complete stage blocks or complete replica blocks, respectively.

Each non-tight capacity-eight bin has reduced cost greater than `3/250` on the inherited cap bracket. At T20 the normalized moment penalties exceed `5571/327040000` and `9/130816`; both complete inherited moments exceed one at the bracket's left endpoint. The result is conditional on the pinned inventory, the inherited source-window model (the one PR #3153 used to check PR #3148's T740 allocation), additive bin pricing and the inherited local paid profile. Arbitrary interleaved T20 orders remain open. No supplier or new kappa is claimed.

Artifact: `research/coupled-t20-window-audit/`, commit `941810a486b6f6b4701194fcf5aead6fbaa74d24`. Seven new package files; frozen predecessors, shared tools and the selected result are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

The [claim is in discussion #3145](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3145#discussioncomment-19001819). The full task card is in `research/coupled-t20-window-audit/TASK.json`.

- Task/track: `complex-new-helper-inventory` / `complex-mechanisms`; single chooser nonce `040d85d315302c1011c104d7d415cc28`; scope key `5868e5281a1e63d41a22`.
- Actual object: `coupled-T20-two-orders-window-obstruction`. Scope **changed** from proposing an inventory to PR #3153's explicit smaller-replica handoff with inventory fixed. The third suggestion exposed Discussion #3145; PR #3148/#3153 already completed its original T740 journal task.
- Domain: nine stages, 408 helpers per call, eighteen idle children and 112 ports. Only two T20 orders are constructed for the audit; the general formulas follow from the written proof. Both providers have 99 width-eight roles per call.
- Milestone: audit/scoped obstruction. Stop after the source-window and cost implications; no allocation synthesis. The complete inherited local profile remains `{1:2433,2:724,3:228,4:102,5:20,8:8}` per call. The inherited stock identity would count 18,429 families at T20, conditional on a complete realization.
- Success evidence: exact source cuts, Hall-count witnesses, positive shipped-order control and strict dual cost penalties. Unknowns: arbitrary interleavings, all-width assignments, native/physical/prefix/outer admission and all-size obligations. The bounded session stopped at the declared obstruction.
- Base and final fetched main: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Refresh at 2026-10-17T17:36:47Z found no changed paths or guidance.

Exact predecessors: [PR #3153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3153) `c509607d1208396ec0045f0ab79f8392fce40b01` supplies the cap audit, reused arithmetic and handoff; [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148) `f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176` constructs T740; [PR #3143](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3143) `dcfaf1d1a7cfebaab22b95776a36a543bc684d50` supplies the T74 comparison. PR #3133 supplies the coupled inventory, and [PR #2979](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2979) `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576` the allocation order, plan and template read here. All consumed bytes are pinned to the base in `SOURCES.json`.

Offline overlap queries covered the card, `T20 AND coupled`, and `stage-major AND coupled`, main packages and Discussion #3145. Final snapshots report 249 open PRs including drafts at 17:26:19.594925Z and 2,001 discussion records at 17:27:03.117721Z on 17 October, with complete pagination. The refined query found only this claim/package. A later snapshot (253 open PRs at 17:49:11Z, 2,015 discussion records at 17:39:04Z) shows no other T20 chronology work. Open PRs #3184, #3190 and #3198 report higher conditional kappa on PR #3148's T740 fill by moving idle capacity between bins; that lies outside the one-idle-child-per-bin pricing assumed here, and this audit neither covers nor compares them. Unpublished work and arbitrary diffs are outside this coverage.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library only. The registered replay and all nine behavioral groups pass.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/coupled-t20-window-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/coupled-t20-window-audit/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-t20-window-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/coupled-t20-window-audit
```

Expected primary output:

```text
PASS_COUPLED_T20_WINDOW_AUDIT stage_major_deficit=1857 replica_major_deficit=7500 baseline_T74_deficit=0 cap8_bad_penalty_gt=3/250
```

The new forward reconstruction matches all 666 serialized T37 windows. The shipped T74 order matches all 49,728 required bins in the necessary relaxation. A separate exhaustive subset oracle agrees on 5,670 small matching cases. Controls reject incorrect window boundaries, capacity overflow, family aliasing, missing ports, duplicate/noncausal calls, provider/primal mutations and corrupted sources. The full optimized CLI passes. The inherited exact arithmetic replays all 2,551 patterns and all six non-tight capacity-eight patterns; this is authenticated reuse, not a claimed independent arithmetic engine.

Metadata/pins, whitespace checks and all 13 package/input publication-byte comparisons pass. A Git-free export of committed implementation and declared inputs passes under `-I -O -Werror -B`.

Not run: native compilation, all-width physical allocation, complete selected cold replay, physical stock/prefix/outer admission, hosted CI, proof-assistant checking or all-size/analytic validation. The positive matching control is a necessary relaxation, not a full allocation certificate.

## Open next questions

Can a genuinely interleaved T20 order attain the cap? First enforce the three per-owner stage gaps of at least three calls for stage pairs (1,2), (3,4), (5,6), then the complete capacity-eight interval matching constraints. Passing still leaves a tight all-width assignment, physical-family exclusions, bridges/frames, restoration and the complete physical/prefix/outer bill. This result does not prove T740 necessary.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The handoff-first process exposed a concrete remaining question. The chooser still surfaced Discussion #3145's original T740 HANDOFF although later comments record completion. Updating that canonical block to the smaller-replica question would reduce repeated intake of completed work.
